legacy.JEV1: historical read/display retained; absent scientific identity cannot qualify new claims
legacy.writes: checked v2 payload in compatible JEV1 frames

physical: validated requires identified specimen/material, measurement origin and acquisition bytes; synthetic/simulation cannot produce this label
scoped_fail: valid applicable unrounded observation fails its declared criterion
release_authorization: always separate; this resolver never authorizes release/manufacturing
software_receipts: offline support only; no alternate scientific truth engine
inventory_authority: Opaque TrustedInventory admitted from approved out-of-band content reference + requirement roots; incoming labels/rehashes do not authorize criterion changes
physical_qualification_provider: unavailable until S13 authenticated lab/passport reduction; declared acquisition metadata cannot qualify
unicode: raw UTF-8 preserved; NFC-equivalent domain IDs and object keys cannot collide; general JSON keys are not domain IDs
review_authority: Opaque TrustedReview admitted from authenticated out-of-band reference/reviewer/scope; closed review receipt binds exact observation hash/action/sequence/reviewer/scope. Incoming labels/bytes cannot establish authority; no signature verification is claimed. Without a trusted review provider support remains incomplete.
